keyword: how much do astronauts get paid to go to the moon
claims: NASA astronauts do not receive a special bonus or overtime pay for traveling to the moon.
NASA astronauts earn their regular government salary for traveling to the moon.

U.S. astronauts' compensation on lunar missions like Artemis II covers standard salary, not per-trip bonuses.
Active astronauts generally earn between $89,693 and $152,258 per year.
According to KING 5 and a Reddit thread, astronauts do not receive overtime or special hazardous-duty pay for lunar missions.
